releases.name: Scroll Reverser Build 20620 -- v2.0 candidate 1
releases.body: This is a beta leading towards Scroll Reverser 2.0. It is a major update aiming to solve common pain points of the 1.x versions, whilst remaining simple and easy to use. I never expected when I created this app 15 years ago that I'd still be updating it in 2026, but here we are, and it still seems to be as popular as ever! The app remains free and open source — see the code at . What's new: - **A setting for each device.** Each trackpad, mouse or other input device now has its own individual setting so you can set each one exactly how you like it. Devices appear in Settings › Scrolling the first time you use them. - **More reliable and more efficient.** Scroll Reverser no longer detects a trackpad by counting the fingers touching it via gesture events. Instead, it reads device information directly. This was a frequent source of unreliability in previous versions. - **Only needs Accessibility permission.** Input Monitoring permission is no longer required. - **Better support for remote input devices.** Scrolling sources such as Universal Control and Screen Sharing each get their own setting, letting you tweak your setup more precisely than before. _After upgrading from 1.x, please check your individual devices in Settings › Scrolling._

releases.name: Scroll Reverser 1.9.1
releases.body:
- Fixed issues where Scroll Reverser could stop working randomly or after waking from sleep.
- Fixed the menu bar icon sometimes appearing blurry on displays with a different resolution from the main display.
- Fixed long lines in the debug console wrapping incorrectly.
- "Preferences" is now called "Settings", to match macOS.
- Updated Sparkle (auto-update framework) to version 2.10.0.
- Added Persian translation, and corrected to the Swedish and Polish translations.

## New Contributors
* @eendriu92 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/pull/198
* @RDIL made their first contribution in https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/pull/197
* @ChaoXu-hub made their first contribution in https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/pull/206
* @telj89 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/pull/208
* @aliafshany made their first contribution in https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/pull/210

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pilotmoon/Scroll-Reverser/compare/v1.9...v1.9.1

releases.name: Build 10558
releases.body:
- Fixed Scroll Reverser failing to launch on macOS 13 Ventura in the previous beta (build 10556).
- Removed an unused `x-pilotmoon-scroll-reverser://` URL scheme, left over from the old Start at Login helper.
